read.en: Applied Materials rose 0.9% on Oct 19 to $413.11, its first gain in ten sessions, but faded from $427.66 to close near the day's low. It is below the falling 5-day ($432.7), 10-day ($472.8), 30-day ($473.2) and 100-day ($516.4) averages and the rising 200-day ($439.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($505.9), and RSI is 30.8.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月19日上涨 0.9%，收于 $413.11，为十个交易日来首次上涨，但自 $427.66 回落，收于当日低点附近。股价位于下行的 5 日（$432.7）、10 日（$472.8）、30 日（$473.2）和 100 日均线（$516.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$439.8）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$505.9），RSI 为 30.8。

read.en: The rebound pushed into the $426–430 zone (Sep 3 low, Oct 15 close) intraday, then faded back into the $411.5–418 band (Sep 16 and Oct 15 lows). Resistance is $418, then $426–433 (Sep 3 low, 5-day average) and $439.8 (200-day). Support is $407.3 (Oct 16 low), then $397 (May 19 low) and $377–380 (April lows). A close below $397 would open $377–380.
